evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Quinton frames the gate as a direct response to a failure — 'the whole reason' carries urgency-as-worry, high arousal over a negative incident.
Summary register — settled, low-arousal cataloguing of resolved decisions; no urgency or alarm surfaces in the wording.

mints.name: IncidentDrivenUrgency
mints.title: urgency anchored to a prior failure as the justification for a new control
mints.frame: Is the pressure here entering as alarm over a concrete past incident, rather than as the speaker's own forward-looking stake?
